title: WILO data
description: Single source for WILO's data shapes. Everything lives under users/{uid}/. Paths: profile/current, plans/{planId}, assigned/{docId}, completed/{docId}, reviews/{reviewId}. wilo_data.py validates against this file, and the coach reads it.

profile.description: users/{uid}/profile/current. Who the athlete is. Outlasts plans; the coach reads it at the start of every conversation.

facts.description: Lasting facts: injuries, weak sides, constraints.

preferences.description: How the athlete likes workouts built.

rules.description: Standing coaching rules, in plain language. The coach applies them when planning and reviewing.

facts: Right leg is the weak side: no basic crane on the right; single-leg curl R 9,6 vs L 10,10 (2026-10-06)
rules: If the right-side crane fails, regress to basic cranes and skip step-ups

plan.description: users/{uid}/plans/{planId}. What the athlete is working on now. Open-ended: it lasts until it's changed in conversation. At most one plan is active.

reasoning.description: Why the plan is built this way.

week.description: Default weekly layout. The coach turns it into dated workouts one week at a time.

progression.description: Plain-language progression rules for this plan.

examples.goal: Bring the right leg up to the left
progression: Progress only what was fully completed; repeat what wasn't

workout.description: users/{uid}/assigned/{docId} (planned) and users/{uid}/completed/{docId} (done). Same shape; completed adds finishedAt and the logged sets. id is shared between an assigned workout and its completed copy.

planId.description: Plan this workout belongs to; null for a one-off.

scheduledFor.description: Local date the workout is for (YYYY-MM-DD). The tracker uses it to pick today's workout.

assignedFor.description: When the coach posted it (not the workout date). The name is kept for tracker compatibility.

exId.description: Stable key across workouts (step-up, dead-hang). Links an exercise's history.

cue.description: Coach instruction. Empty by default (athlete preference).

custom_name.description: Header for one free-text column per set. Conventions: Risers (step-up height), Side (R/L), Direction (Drag/Pull). Two values: use R@3, or split the exercise.

fallback.description: Easier variant the athlete can swap to.

original.description: Set by the tracker while swapped: the original name, note and sets.

target.description: Legacy: the tracker infers timed from target.duration_sec. Drop it once the tracker reads timed directly (#29).

lbs.description: Weight. "" or 0 = bodyweight / not set. Allowed on timed sets (weighted holds).

reps.description: Reps, or seconds when the exercise is timed. "" = not set.

custom.description: Value for the exercise's custom_name column, e.g. "3", "R".

review.description: users/{uid}/reviews/{reviewId}. Written by the coach after each workout (kind: workout) and once a week (kind: week).

completedId.description: kind: workout. The completed doc reviewed.

weekOf.description: kind: week. The Monday of the week reviewed.

completion.description: MVP metric (#25): workouts done / scheduled, sets logged / planned.

changes.description: What changed in the profile, plan or next week, and why.

examples.summary: Lunge stretch done 4/4 at #2. Step-ups skipped by the crane rule.
findings: Right leg weaker: no right-side crane; curls R 9,6 vs L 10,10
changes: Profile: add right-leg fact and crane rule
